description: Ask Verse's "distance" skill (Sky and earth), one of the proven skills with the most evidence that Verse offers over MCP (read-only): rated proven on a-to-mind.com from evidence (real asks in Verse's benchmark, its tests), never from how it describes itself. Asks like "distance from london to paris", "how far is paris from berlin", "how far is new york from boston". Over MCP it is answered the way ask_void is: Verse's answer engine (a model, citing Wikipedia when it matches; up to 12 a minute per caller). The skill itself works it out on its own card at the "open" link in the result.

ask.description: The ask in plain words (3 to 600 characters), e.g. "distance from london to paris".

response_type.description: What to get back: 'text' (default) or 'raw_data' (the structured result as JSON). 'image' is not offered yet.
